## Design note

The family car with a grudge. Two tonnes of four-door land yacht on a lazy three-speed, but the torque arrives early and the limited-slip axle and the optional steel-belted radials (where the coupe keeps its bias-plies) put it down, so it lights up both rear tires on demand and holds a slide like a barge holds a course. Soft, slow steering and period brakes mean every move needs planning — and nothing in traffic wants to argue with it.

## How this car breaks

Thick mild-steel panels and chrome battering-ram bumpers on a long nose: low-speed hits barely mark it, and the long front overhang gives more crush room than the coupe. The cabin is still a 70s mild-steel cell with no real crumple management, four doors means four soft spots in a T-bone, the leaf-sprung live axle tears its hangers out in a rear hit. The tank sits behind the axle under the trunk floor like the coupe's, but behind a longer rear overhang: a 40 km/h rear hit stops short of it.

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Engine

6.6 L OHV pushrod V8, high-output heads and cam, 4-barrel carburettor, dual exhaust (net rating). Net (installed) output class for early-70s high-output 6.6 L four-barrel V8s (~205 kW at 4400 rpm, ~508 N·m at 2800), i.e. well below the period gross ratings; a small-bore, longer-revving engine than the 7.2 L big-block, with less torque at the bottom.

Peak **202 kW @ 4400 rpm**, **508 N·m @ 2800 rpm**. Idle 700 / redline 5000 / limiter 5300 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.28 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 61 N·m. Power-to-weight 105 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

3-speed automatic with torque converter, clutch-type limited-slip live rear axle. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.35, coast ramp 0.20. Torque converter: stall 2000 rpm, 2.1× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2600 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.50 × peak torque = 760 N·m. Shift time 0.40 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.48 | 8.01 | 79 |
| 2 | 1.48 | 4.78 | 133 |
| 3 | 1.00 | 3.23 | 197 |

Final drive 3.23, reverse 2.08. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.338 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.22 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 505 kg | 1.05 Hz | 22000 N/m | 1470 N·s/m | 2200 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 374 kg | 1.15 Hz | 19500 N/m | 1190 N·s/m | 1780 N·s/m | 0.22 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **1760 / 3520 N·s/m F, 1430 / 2850 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 6.5°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.462 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 76756 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 28162 F / 24394 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **7000 F / 2500 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 6.5°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 120000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.2° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 2.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 65 bar.

- Front: 298 mm disc, pistons per side 79 mm → A = 49.0 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 124 mm, pad μ = 0.3: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.3·65 bar·49.0 cm²·0.124 m = **2370 N·m**
- Rear: 279 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 23.8 mm → A = 4.45 cm², drum radius 140 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **726 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2360 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.00×), rear needs 819 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.89×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 822 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity is below that (hardware-limited rear), so `bias_front` = **0.5**: both axles get full caliper torque → delivered 2370 N·m front / 730 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 2100 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 18.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 13.4 m → outer-front path radius 6.59 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.03 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.548 rad (31.4°)** (outer 27.8°, inner 36.0° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 1.0 rad/s.
